limitations: Saved-run replay is not new generation.
Command syntax/assertion-text classification alone is not proof of adequate or executed assertions.
No captured shell command is executed; only frozen independent oracles run in the checker sandbox.
Typed specs are AST-extracted JSON from actual native commands and matched byte for byte to the frozen compiler; raw model helper calls and later full native requests were not retained.
Typed cases and success markers are model-supplied checks, separate from hidden independent-oracle results; a successful supplied check does not establish complete task coverage.
A static semantic error command contains no submitted spec or target code, so it proves native feedback recovery, not task correctness or what malformed fields were supplied.
A case-binding error is emitted after module loading but before any target-function invocation; it is not an implementation assertion failure.
Helper-preparation normal-settings snapshot is supplementary; its timing must not be substituted for the runner pre-study observation.
Listener closure is a recorded owner receipt; no network connections are opened to reenact it.
Known development tasks and one frozen sample per case/arm do not establish general qualification.
